pli-tv-kd7:12.1.26: tattha ce me phāsu bhavissati vasissāmi no ce me phāsu bhavissati paccessanti.
pli-tv-kd7:12.1.28: so katacīvaro paccessaṃ paccessanti bahiddhā kaṭhinuddhāraṃ vītināmeti.
pli-tv-kd7:12.1.30: bhikkhu atthatakaṭhino phāsuvihāriko cīvaraṃ ādāya pakkamati amukaṃ nāma āvāsaṃ gamissāmi
pli-tv-kd7:12.1.31: tattha ce me phāsu bhavissati vasissāmi no ce me phāsu bhavissati amukaṃ nāma āvāsaṃ gamissāmi
pli-tv-kd7:12.1.32: tattha ce me phāsu bhavissati vasissāmi no ce me phāsu bhavissati amukaṃ nāma āvāsaṃ gamissāmi
pli-tv-kd7:12.1.33: tattha ce me phāsu bhavissati vasissāmi no ce me phāsu bhavissati paccessanti.
pli-tv-kd7:12.1.35: so katacīvaro paccessaṃ paccessanti sambhuṇāti kaṭhinuddhāraṃ.
pli-tv-kd7:13.1.1: dveme bhikkhave kaṭhinassa palibodhā dve apalibodhā.
pli-tv-kd7:13.1.2: katame ca bhikkhave dve kaṭhinassa palibodhā.
pli-tv-kd7:13.1.5: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vasati vā tasmiṃ āvāse sāpekkho vā pakkamati paccessanti.
pli-tv-kd7:13.1.8: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno cīvaraṃ akataṃ vā hoti vippakataṃ vā cīvarāsā vā anupacchinnā.
pli-tv-kd7:13.1.10: ime kho bhikkhave dve kaṭhinassa palibodhā.
pli-tv-kd7:13.2.1: katame ca bhikkhave dve kaṭhinassa apalibodhā.
pli-tv-kd7:13.2.4: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu pakkamati tamhā āvāsā cattena vantena muttena anapekkhena na paccessanti.
pli-tv-kd7:13.2.7: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno cīvaraṃ kataṃ vā hoti naṭṭhaṃ vā vinaṭṭhaṃ vā daḍḍhaṃ vā cīvarāsā vā upacchinnā.
pli-tv-kd7:13.2.9: ime kho bhikkhave dve kaṭhinassa apalibodhāti.
pli-tv-kd7:13.2.10: kaṭhinakkhandhakaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ sattamaṃ. imamhi khandhake vatthū doḷasa peyyālamukhāni ekaṃ sataṃ aṭṭhārasa.
